answer: Identity without cost is inventory. Admission requires 4 GB of sequential memory per key, so one rack cannot mint a thousand parallel identities. A zenith of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the falcon of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and trellis-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Stake forfeited is the only argument fakes understand.
